description:
Creates a Google player, or signs an existing Google player in when signInIfExists is explicitly enabled.
Use when: the player completes Google OAuth and explicitly chooses registration or one-click signup/signin.
Not for: probing horizon_signin_google then reusing its authorization code for signup. Google codes are single-use; obtain a fresh code after any uncertain exchange.
Requires: a fresh Google authorization code and its exact redirect URI from the app's OAuth flow, plus the server's configured Google OAuth client.
Side effects: exchanges the code once. signInIfExists omitted/false keeps strict signup semantics; true authenticates an existing Google identity. It does not link a different email/provider account.
Returns: 201 user details and accessToken for new users or signInIfExists=true existing users, even without refresh opt-in. includeRefreshToken=true adds refreshToken and both expiry timestamps. The server derives the name from the Google email; use horizon_change_name later.
Errors: 409 on an existing identity in strict signup mode or conflicting email. 400 for invalid provider data. Never automatically retry an uncertain exchange or reuse a spent code. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

googleAuthorizationCode.description: Fresh single-use Google authorization code obtained by the player's OAuth consent flow (max 2000 characters)

googleRedirectUri.description: Exact redirect URI used to obtain the Google authorization code; empty string for configured native flows (max 500 characters)

includeRefreshToken.description: Explicit opt-in to a rotating 30-day refresh session; omitted or false preserves access-only behavior. Store refresh tokens in platform secure storage

signInIfExists.description: Explicitly enable one-click Google registration/signin with one code exchange; omitted/false remains signup-only

name: horizon_signup_google
title: Sign Up with Google
